The runtime uses the bands for the association's own league positions and cup slots; qualifying rounds are not modelled yet.

rebalancing.rule: When a title holder is already qualified its berth is not wasted: the best-coefficient club still in the qualifying rounds is pulled into the league phase and the hole behind it is filled from the round below.

entries.quote: as the domestic champions with the highest club coefficient among the clubs that would otherwise have entered the Champions Path of the qualifying phase or play-off round, entered the league phase instead of the Champions Path second qualifying round.
as the two clubs with the highest club coefficient that would otherwise have entered the Champions Path first qualifying round, entered the Champions Path second qualifying round.

as the club with the highest club coefficient among all clubs that would otherwise have entered either the Champions Path or the League Path of the qualifying phase or play-off round, entered the league phase instead of the League Path third qualifying round.
as the two clubs with the highest club coefficient that would otherwise have entered the League Path second qualifying round, entered the League Path third qualifying round.

rebalancing.knock_on: Every promotion leaves a hole filled from the round below, so the league phase stays at 36 and every qualifying round stays even. Loser counts in drop_downs are post-rebalancing.

ucl_winner.rule: Champions League winner gets a league-phase berth if not already qualified through the domestic league.
ucl_winner.quote: The winners of the 2025-26 UEFA Champions League and 2025-26 UEFA Europa League were each given an additional entry if they did not qualify for the 2026-27 UEFA Champions League through their domestic league.
ucl_winner.actual_2026_27: Paris Saint-Germain qualified as Ligue 1 champions, so the slot was rebalanced (see rebalancing).

uel_winner.rule: Europa League winner gets a Champions League league-phase berth if not already qualified through the domestic league.
uel_winner.actual_2026_27: Aston Villa qualified 4th in the Premier League, so the slot was rebalanced.

uecl_winner.rule: Conference League winner gets a Europa League league-phase berth if not already qualified for the Champions League or Europa League.
uecl_winner.quote: The title holders of the 2025-26 UEFA Conference League received an entry into the Europa League (if they did not qualify for the Champions League or Europa League via league position).
uecl_winner.actual_2026_27: Crystal Palace entered the Europa League league phase as CON.

traps: Use the coefficient snapshot that matches the season, not the live one. The 2026-27 access list uses the ranking finished at the end of 2024-25; the live 2026-27 table on the UEFA_coefficient page feeds 2028-29.
Russia is 26th with 0 teams. Do not allocate its berth: the slot is absorbed by pushing the association-23 champion up a round.
Liechtenstein has no league and no Champions League entrant: exactly one club, the cup winner, into UECL Q2.

Team numbers per association are fixed first; the entry round is what moves. A cup winner already qualified for the Champions League frees its Europa League slot, and it cascades down the league table.

Round names are path-specific. There is no single UEL Q3: it is Q3 Champions Path (12) plus Q3 Main Path (14). UECL Q2/Q3/play-off each split into Champions Path and League Path (the same path is called Main Path in some sections of the same page).
Champions Path losers from UCL Q3 go to the Europa League play-off round, but League Path losers from the same UCL Q3 go straight to the Europa League league phase. Same round, different destination.
UCL Q1 losers do not all land in UECL Q2: the published list gave two of them a bye to UECL Q3 Champions Path because the Champions Path above them had been thinned by rebalancing.
A cup runner-up gets nothing unless the winner's slot cascades.

afc.allocation_rule: Slots are not fixed per country: they follow the AFC Club Competitions Ranking, recomputed after the previous season, split into a West and an East region. The top association in each region gets 4 league-stage + 1 play-off berth, and the scale steps down from there. ACL Two slots come from the same ranking with a separate, flatter scale. The winner of ACL Two is promoted into the next ACL Elite play-off; the winner of the Challenge League into the next ACL Two group stage.

competitions.name: CAF Champions League
competitions.clubs_note: 61 entered from 48 associations; 16 reach the group stage

competitions.name: CAF Confederation Cup
competitions.clubs_note: 56 entered from 44 associations; 16 reach the group stage

caf.allocation_rule: One berth for every member association that enters, plus a second berth for the 12 highest-ranked associations in the CAF 5-year ranking. The reigning Champions League holder is also entitled to enter, but no association may be represented by more than two clubs, so the holder only adds a berth if its own association has room. Theoretical maximum 68 clubs; the quota is a flat 1-or-2 per country, not a sliding scale.

caf.drop_down_note: None. Both competitions are closed ladders: 61 CL entrants play two knockout rounds down to 16 group-stage clubs, and 56 Confederation Cup entrants do the same. No Champions League loser is transferred to the Confederation Cup in 2026-27 (the same was true in 2025-26). Do not model a drop-down for CAF.

competitions.name: CONCACAF Champions Cup
competitions.clubs_note: 10 associations; 5 byes to the round of 16, 22 into round one

concacaf.allocation_rule: A fixed quota by zone and by qualifying competition, not an association ranking. The North American Zone gets 18 berths split Mexico 6 / USA 8 / Canada 4; the Central American Zone 6; the Caribbean Zone 3. 12 of the 27 berths come from three international competitions (Leagues Cup, Caribbean Cup, Central American Cup), so a country's total is not a pure league quota.

champions_cup.note: Apertura/Clausura champion with the better aggregate; bye to the round of 16
bye; the Leagues Cup berth is not tied to a league
Canadian MLS clubs compete for the US-side MLS berths

concacaf.drop_down_note: None. Single-elimination bracket: round-one losers are out, there is no secondary CONCACAF club competition to fall into.

qualifying_window.note: round one 3-4 and 17-19 Feb / 10-12 and 24-26 Feb; round of 16 10-19 Mar; final 30 May 2026

concacaf.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2026_CONCACAF_Champions_Cup citing https://www.concacaf.com/champions-cup/news/2026-concacaf-champions-cup-key-details/ and the 2026 CONCACAF Champions Cup regulations
concacaf.quote: Twenty-seven teams qualified for the tournament, with five qualifying directly to the round of 16. The remaining 22 teams entered in round one. In addition to national league competitions in the United States, Mexico, and Canada, 12 of 27 berths were determined by international competitions, including the 2025 Leagues Cup (three), 2025 CONCACAF Caribbean Cup (three), and 2025 CONCACAF Central American Cup (six).
notes: Leagues Cup nominally supplies 3 berths (champion, runner-up, third place); the 2026 team list contains only 2 (Seattle as champion, LA Galaxy as third place), so one berth was absorbed. Verify the Leagues Cup line each season.
Round one is two-legged; the round of 16, quarter-finals, semi-finals and final are also two-legged, with the final a single match.

competitions.name: OFC Men's Champions League
competitions.clubs_note: 8 in the group stage: 7 direct + 1 qualifying-stage winner

ofc.allocation_rule: Exactly one berth per member association, for all 11 associations. There is no ranking and no second berth. Seven associations enter the group stage directly and four play a qualifying stage for the last group-stage place.
ofc.drop_down_note: None. One competition, single bracket; qualifying-stage losers are out.

qualifying_window.note: qualifying stage in Samoa; competition proper 9-22 Aug 2026 in Fiji

ofc.quote: A total of 11 teams from all 11 OFC member associations may enter the competition. Seven associations (Fiji, New Caledonia, New Zealand, Papua New Guinea, Solomon Islands, Tahiti, Vanuatu) are awarded one berth each in the group stage. Four associations (American Samoa, Cook Islands, Samoa, Tonga) are awarded one berth each in the qualifying stage, with the winners advancing to the group stage.
notes: From 2026 the OFC Champions League winner no longer takes the FIFA Club World Cup / Intercontinental Cup berth; the OFC Professional League champion does. Do not link the two.
